# Panxo — Style Reference

> Warm carbon ink on drafting film, a sunset sealed under frosted glass. Mona Sans at 500 over Inter body copy, a #fafafa canvas ruled by dashed column guides, ring-shadow pills, and a single ember link in the black announcement strip.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Panxo uses a ruled-drafting-sheet product language. The base is a #fafafa Fog Canvas crossed by dashed vertical column guides. White #ffffff Paper carries the nav, cards and buttons, recessed #ededed Pebble Tile blocks hold the stats, and one inverted #1c1a17 Carbon Ink slab provides contrast. The chromatic budget is one. Ember Signal #ff6020 appears only as the announcement-bar link, and Mint Pulse #10b981 is held back for status. Every other saturated hue lives inside the hero gradient photograph or the product-demo highlights. Hierarchy comes from a single warm ink at falling opacities (#1c1a17, #1c1a17b8, #1c1a178f) rather than from a gray ramp. Mona Sans at weight 500 sets 24 to 56px headlines with tracking between -0.01em and -0.03em, over Inter body at 14 and 16px. The heading steps 24/32/40/56 run close to a Perfect Fourth. Every action is a pill and every container sits at 8 to 12px. Elevation comes from hairline ring shadows instead of drop shadows. The page reads as an engineer's specification sheet rather than an ad-tech sales deck.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fog Canvas | `#fafafa` | `--color-fog-canvas` | Body background, icon-tile fills and badge fills (21 background uses). It is a cool off-white that lets #ffffff surfaces lift without any shadow. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | Nav bar, directory cards, secondary pills and the demo's inner card (41 uses, the most frequent fill). Elevation here comes from fill contrast, not depth. |
| Pebble Tile | `#ededed` | `--color-pebble-tile` | Stat tiles and recessed metric blocks (6 uses). It is darker than the canvas, so these blocks sink into the page instead of floating above it. |
| Frosted Glass | `#ffffff8f` | `--color-frosted-glass` | The translucent control tray and tab chips laid over the hero gradient (4 uses). It is the only glass surface. Do not use it on flat canvas, where it reads as a muddy gray. |
| Carbon Ink | `#1c1a17` | `--color-carbon-ink` | Headlines, primary text, the primary pill fill and the inverted stat tile (183 text uses, 9 fills). Its warm brown-black is the system's one true voice. |
| Slate Label | `#52525b` | `--color-slate-label` | Badge text and icon-tile glyphs in the publisher directory (12 uses). It is a cool zinc that keeps metadata separate from the warm ink of the body copy. |
| Graphite Ink | `#1c1a17b8` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Paragraphs, unselected filter chips and secondary nav links (128 uses). This 72% step of Carbon Ink keeps body copy tonally related to the headlines. |
| Ash Caption | `#1c1a178f` | `--color-ash-caption` | Captions, company names under domains, and the muted second clause of split headlines (73 uses). The 56% step is the system's whisper. Do not use it for interactive labels. |
| Mist Border | `#f4f4f5` | `--color-mist-border` | Card outlines, badge strokes and icon-tile rims (24 uses). The hairline is close to invisible and marks edges without drawing boxes. |
| Pewter Hairline | `#0000001f` | `--color-pewter-hairline` | Filter-chip outlines and section dividers (8 uses). A 12% black stroke gives slightly firmer edges for interactive pills. |
| Ember Signal | `#ff6020` | `--color-ember-signal` | The "Schedule a meeting" link in the black announcement bar and its 12% tinted backdrops (2 fills, 1 text). It is the only chrome accent. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Mint Pulse | `#10b981` | `--color-mint-pulse` | Live-status dots and positive indicators (6 uses). Status is its only job. Do not use it for buttons or headings. |
| Amethyst Highlight | `#a855f7` | `--color-amethyst-highlight` | Inline entity highlights inside the product demo, such as the confidence score (6 uses). It is decorative and belongs to the mockup's syntax coloring, not to the interface chrome. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Mona Sans — the display voice, medium-weight and tightly tracked for every headline and stat · `--font-mona-sans`

- **Substitute:** Mona Sans at 500 (it is open source and is the recommended route), Geist at 500, Inter Display at 500. Mona Sans draws slightly wider and a touch heavier than Inter at the same nominal weight. Do not drop the substitute to 400, or headlines will read thin.
- **Weights:** 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 24px, 32px, 40px, 56px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 56px, 1.125 at 32px, 1.2 at 24px and 40px
- **Letter spacing:** -0.56px at 56px; -1.68px at 56px (weight 700 stat numerals); -0.4px at 40px; -1.6px at 40px (closing CTA headline); 0px at 32px; -0.72px at 24px; -0.96px at 24px (tight variant)
- **OpenType features:** `"blwf"`, `"cv03"`, `"cv04"`, `"cv09"`, `"cv11"`
- **Role:** Weight 500 at display sizes is the signature. It is heavier than the editorial 400 move and quieter than the 600–700 most SaaS heroes default to, so headlines feel engineered, not shouted. The 56px ceiling is deliberately low against the 72–80px convention, which makes the hero about 3.5× the 16px body instead of 5×. Tracking tightens with emphasis: -0.01em on standard heads, -0.03em on stat numerals and the closing CTA. The stylistic sets (`cv03`, `cv04`, `cv09`, `cv11`) swap in single-storey and alternate glyphs for a more technical face.

### Inter — the UI and body workhorse, from 9px micro-labels to 18px leads · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 (open source, the same face), Geist at 400, Public Sans at 400. Inter renders true to its nominal weight, so match weights one for one.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 9px, 10px, 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.2 (normal) for UI labels, 1.33 at 12px and 18px, 1.43 at 14px, 1.5 at 13px and 16px
- **Letter spacing:** -0.18px at 18px; -0.16px at 16px; -0.14px at 14px; -0.13px at 13px (paragraph variant); +0.48px at 12px (uppercase eyebrow); +0.45px at 9px (uppercase micro-label); 0px on 11px badges and 13px buttons
- **OpenType features:** `"blwf"`, `"cv03"`, `"cv04"`, `"cv09"`, `"cv11"`
- **Role:** Inter carries everything that is not a headline: 247 uses at 400 and 116 at 500. Running text gets a uniform -0.01em, a small tightening that makes paragraphs sit closer to the Mona Sans heads. Uppercase labels flip to positive tracking (+0.04em to +0.05em), the conventional fix that keeps caps legible at 9 to 12px. Weight 700 is used only for directory card titles at 15px. It is a small, ledger-like emphasis, not a headline weight.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 500 | 11px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.33 | 0.48px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | -0.14px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | -0.16px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 500 | 18px | 1.33 | -0.18px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Mona Sans | 500 | 24px | 1.2 | -0.72px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Mona Sans | 500 | 32px | 1.125 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Mona Sans | 500 | 40px | 1.2 | -0.4px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Mona Sans | 500 | 56px | 1.0 | -0.56px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Mona Sans weight 500 between 24px and 56px — medium weight with tightened tracking is the signature voice and must hold across all section heads.
- Step text hierarchy through opacities of one ink: #1c1a17, then #1c1a17b8, then #1c1a178f — related tones read as one material instead of three unrelated grays.
- Make every action a pill (999px, 48px or 20px on heights of 34–40px) and every container 8–12px — the round/square split tells users what is clickable before they read it.
- Draw secondary-button edges with the `--shadow-subtle` 1px ring instead of a border — it gives a crisper outline with less visual weight.
- Keep saturated color inside the 24px-radius hero gradient stage and the 6 mockup highlights in #a855f7 — the interface chrome stays monochrome, so the product demo becomes the only colorful moment.
- Pair a 12px uppercase eyebrow at +0.48px tracking with each 40px heading — it labels sections without a colored tag.
- Treat the dashed column guides on the 1128px frame as non-negotiable page furniture — they turn the canvas into a measured sheet and justify the low-elevation surfaces.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary CTA with #ff6020 Ember Signal — orange is limited to one announcement link, and a colored CTA would break the rule that action equals ink.
- Don't bump headlines to weight 700 for impact — the medium-weight voice depends on restraint, and 700 belongs only to the 56px stat numerals.
- Don't introduce a cool gray ramp such as a 600/500/400 text palette next to #1c1a17 — mixed warm and cool neutrals break the single-ink opacity ladder.
- Don't add 8–24px blur drop shadows to cards — the system uses fills and 1px rings, and soft floating shadows make it look like a generic template.
- Don't round badges to pills — keeping badges at 6px separates static metadata from 999px actions, and that separation is how the page signals affordance.
- Don't push the hero headline to 72px or more to match SaaS convention — the 56px ceiling against 16px body sets the measured, document-like tone.
- Don't let gradients escape the hero stage into section backgrounds — never apply the peach-violet wash to cards or bands, because it would turn the 1-color budget into decoration.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fafafa (Fog Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- recessed surface: #ededed (Pebble Tile)
- primary text: #1c1a17 (Carbon Ink)
- secondary text: #1c1a17b8 (Graphite Ink)
- border: #f4f4f5 (Mist Border)
- accent link: #ff6020 (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #1c1a17 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use the Carbon Ink opacity ladder (#1c1a17, #1c1a17b8, #1c1a178f) as solid fills on #ffffff Paper. A single highlighted series may use #10b981 Mint Pulse or Ember Signal at 12% opacity, so the accent stays quieter than the 56px numerals.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #1c1a17, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 48px, padding 10px 14px, height 40px, display inline-flex with centered alignment, font Inter 14px weight 500, letter-spacing -0.14px, no box-shadow. Place a secondary button 8px to its right: background #ffffff, text #1c1a17, border-radius 999px, padding 10px 16px, height 40px, Inter 14px weight 500, box-shadow `rgba(95, 99, 106, 0.08) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(43, 43, 48, 0.1) 0px 1px 1px 0px`.

2. Build a hero section on #fafafa: a 1080px container centered inside a 1128px frame with 1px dashed vertical lines in #0000001f at the frame edges and the quarter points. Top padding is 88px. Left column: an eyebrow "AI AUDIENCE INTELLIGENCE" in Inter 12px weight 500, uppercase, +0.48px letter-spacing, color #1c1a17, then 16px below it a headline in Mona Sans 56px weight 500, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -0.56px, color #1c1a17. Right column: a lead in Inter 18px weight 500, line-height 1.33, color #1c1a17b8, then the dark and white pill buttons 24px below. Below both columns, 48px down, place a 1080px stage with border-radius 24px containing a decorative peach-to-violet gradient image.

3. Build a stat row: a four-column grid with a 16px gap. The first tile has background #1c1a17, border-radius 8px, padding 40px, and text in Mona Sans 24px weight 500, letter-spacing -0.72px, color #ffffff. The other three have background #ededed, border-radius 8px and padding 40px, with a label at top in Inter 14px weight 400, color #1c1a17b8, and a figure at the bottom in Mona Sans 56px weight 700, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -1.68px, color #1c1a17. No borders or shadows.

4. Build a publisher directory card: background #ffffff, border 1px solid #f4f4f5, border-radius 12px, padding 24px, no shadow. The header row has a 40×40px icon tile (background #fafafa, border 1px solid #f4f4f5, border-radius 10px) and, 12px to its right, a domain in Inter 15px weight 700 #1c1a17 above a company name in Inter 12px weight 400 #1c1a178f. Below, 16px down, a row of badges with a 6px gap: background #fafafa, border 1px solid #f4f4f5, border-radius 6px, padding 4px 10px, Inter 11px weight 500, color #52525b.

5. Build a navigation bar: full width, background #ffffff, bottom border 1px solid #f4f4f5, height 64px, position relative (not sticky), with content constrained to 1080px. The wordmark sits left. Links are centered in Inter 14px weight 500, color #1c1a17, with a 24px gap. At right, a "Sign in" pill (background #ffffff, border-radius 999px, padding 10px 16px, box-shadow `--shadow-subtle`) and a "Get Started" pill (background #1c1a17, text #ffffff, border-radius 48px, padding 10px 14px), 8px apart.

"For Search" carries a 9px uppercase "Early Access" micro-label in Ember Signal. A Sign in pill and the dark Get Started pill sit right. The nav reads as a document header rather than an app toolbar.

### Pill Button — Dark (Primary)

**Role:** Primary conversion action

A carbon capsule. The fill is #1c1a17 Carbon Ink and the text is #ffffff Paper. There is no border, the radius is 48px, padding is 10px 14px and height is 40px. The label is Inter 14px weight 500 with -0.14px tracking, and there is no shadow. The 48px radius on a 40px height renders as a full pill, while the ink fill matches the headline color. The primary action is the darkest object on the page rather than the most colorful, which keeps the CTA tied to the type instead of to a brand hue.

### Pill Button — White (Secondary)

**Role:** Secondary action beside primary

A paper capsule. The fill is #ffffff Paper and the text is #1c1a17 Carbon Ink. The radius is 999px, padding is 10px 16px and height is 40px. The label is Inter 14px weight 500, and the edge is drawn by the `--shadow-subtle` ring (a 1px gray ring plus a 1px drop) instead of a CSS border. It always sits 8px to the right of the dark pill. The ring-as-border technique gives it a crisper edge than a 1px stroke at a fraction of the visual weight.

**Role:** Directory filtering by category

An outlined counter pill. At rest it has a transparent background, text in #1c1a17b8 Graphite Ink, and a 1px #0000001f Pewter Hairline border. The active state fills #ffffff Paper, switches the text to #1c1a17 Carbon Ink and darkens the stroke to a one-off zinc tone (not a system token). ### Publisher Directory Card

**Role:** Marketplace listing for one publisher

A white ledger card. The background is #ffffff Paper with a 1px #f4f4f5 Mist Border. The radius is 12px, padding is 24px and the measured size is 336×246px, with no shadow. **Role:** Metadata tag on cards

The system's one inverted card. The background is #1c1a17 Carbon Ink with faint concentric arc linework in the top-left corner (decorative). The radius is 8px and padding is 40px. **Role:** Animated product demo showcase

A glass console on a sunset. A 1080px-wide container with a 24px radius holds a full-bleed peach-to-violet gradient photograph (decorative, not a token). Beneath sits a Frosted Glass tray holding a dark "Process" pill and a "US Traffic" dropdown pill. This is the only zone where saturated color is allowed in quantity.

### Section Eyebrow

**Role:** Category label above section heads

A tracked uppercase kicker. It is Inter 12px weight 500 in #1c1a17 Carbon Ink, with uppercase transform, +0.48px tracking and 1.33 line height, set 16px above a Mona Sans 40px heading. Examples are "AI AUDIENCE INTELLIGENCE" and "AI AUDIENCES". It has no background, border or bullet. It takes the role of a colored section tag without spending any of the chromatic budget, which keeps the hierarchy purely typographic.

### Feature Accordion List

**Role:** Expandable benefits beside media

A ruled list of rows. Each row is divided by a 1px #0000001f Pewter Hairline. A 16px stroke icon in Carbon Ink precedes a title in Inter 16px weight 500 with -0.16px tracking. The expanded row reveals a description in Inter 14px weight 400 in Graphite Ink, indented 24px to align under the title, with 16px vertical padding per row. There is no fill or radius. This is the tabular, specification-sheet way to present features without inventing a card per benefit.

**Role:** Media credibility row

A ruled band. A full-width #fafafa Fog Canvas strip has 1px #0000001f Pewter Hairline borders at top and bottom and 40px vertical padding. Four monochrome wordmarks (MarketWatch, Financial Post, Business Insider, Yahoo Finance) are set in Carbon Ink, spaced evenly inside the 1080px container, with an edge fade at left that implies a marquee. The logos are stripped of their brand colors, keeping the chromatic budget intact even when third parties appear.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Mona Sans weight 500 between 24px and 56px — medium weight with tightened tracking is the signature voice and must hold across all section heads.
- Step text hierarchy through opacities of one ink: #1c1a17, then #1c1a17b8, then #1c1a178f — related tones read as one material instead of three unrelated grays.
- Make every action a pill (999px, 48px or 20px on heights of 34–40px) and every container 8–12px — the round/square split tells users what is clickable before they read it.
- Draw secondary-button edges with the `--shadow-subtle` 1px ring instead of a border — it gives a crisper outline with less visual weight.
- Keep saturated color inside the 24px-radius hero gradient stage and the 6 mockup highlights in #a855f7 — the interface chrome stays monochrome, so the product demo becomes the only colorful moment.
- Pair a 12px uppercase eyebrow at +0.48px tracking with each 40px heading — it labels sections without a colored tag.
- Treat the dashed column guides on the 1128px frame as non-negotiable page furniture — they turn the canvas into a measured sheet and justify the low-elevation surfaces.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary CTA with #ff6020 Ember Signal — orange is limited to one announcement link, and a colored CTA would break the rule that action equals ink.
- Don't bump headlines to weight 700 for impact — the medium-weight voice depends on restraint, and 700 belongs only to the 56px stat numerals.
- Don't introduce a cool gray ramp such as a 600/500/400 text palette next to #1c1a17 — mixed warm and cool neutrals break the single-ink opacity ladder.
- Don't add 8–24px blur drop shadows to cards — the system uses fills and 1px rings, and soft floating shadows make it look like a generic template.
- Don't round badges to pills — keeping badges at 6px separates static metadata from 999px actions, and that separation is how the page signals affordance.
- Don't push the hero headline to 72px or more to match SaaS convention — the 56px ceiling against 16px body sets the measured, document-like tone.
- Don't let gradients escape the hero stage into section backgrounds — never apply the peach-violet wash to cards or bands, because it would turn the 1-color budget into decoration.

- **Hero demo card and floating chips:** `rgba(17, 26, 37, 0.12) 0px 0px 0px 0.57px, rgba(16, 25, 36, 0.1) 0px 0.46px 1.14px 0px, rgba(16, 25, 36, 0.1) 0px 1.14px 4.57px 0px`
- **Secondary white pills (Sign in, Explore Marketplace):** `rgba(95, 99, 106, 0.08) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(43, 43, 48, 0.1) 0px 1px 1px 0px`
- **Hovered or focused pills and dropdowns:** `rgba(95, 99, 106, 0.12) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(43, 43, 48, 0.1) 0px 1px 4px 0px`

Every shadow leads with a 0px-blur spread ring, so these are outlines with a breath of depth rather than floating layers. The largest blur in the system is 4.57px.

## Imagery

The site uses no lifestyle photography. Its one image is a large abstract gradient render: silky peach, coral and violet folds that fill the 24px-radius hero stage and a second split panel that runs from sky blue to pink. These are decorative backdrops, not system tokens. Product truth comes from live UI mockups layered on top: white 12px-radius cards, frosted pills, and AI-source avatars (ChatGPT and Claude glyphs) in 50% circles with ring shadows. Icons are 16px single-weight line icons in #1c1a17 Carbon Ink with no fills. Press logos are monochrome wordmarks, and the inverted stat tile carries faint concentric arcs. There are no glows or orbs in the chrome itself. The story is invisible AI traffic made visible: soft atmospheric color stands for the conversation, and crisp white instruments measure it.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1080px column inside a 1128px frame. The frame is marked by dashed vertical guides that also split the hero into four columns, a blueprint convention most SaaS sites hide. Sections are separated by 88px of vertical padding and full-width 1px hairlines. The hero is split, with an eyebrow and a 56px two-line headline at left and a 16px lead plus two pills at right. The 1080px gradient stage follows below. Then come a four-up stat row, a four-column press logo band, a centered scroll-reveal manifesto paragraph, and alternating two-column features in which text sits left at roughly 40% and media runs right. The media is allowed to bleed past the frame. The directory uses a three-column card grid. The nav is not sticky: a white bar with the wordmark left, links centered, and Sign in and Get Started right. On phones at 375px, set the display to 40px and use a 64px section gap. Density: comfortable.

## Single Ink Discipline

Every level of text hierarchy is the same warm #1c1a17 at a different alpha: 100% for heads, 72% (#1c1a17b8) for body, and 56% (#1c1a178f) for captions and the muted second clause of split headlines like "AI is shaping audiences *you can not see*." This is the thesis expressed in type: one ink, diluted, does all the work. A cool Tailwind-style gray palette would break it, because the warm undertone would drift between levels and the page would read as assembled rather than printed. A separate link blue would break it too. Extend the system by adding alpha steps only: a 35% step for disabled or unrevealed text, and the 12% step that already serves Pewter Hairline. The only cool neutral allowed is #52525b Slate Label, and only on metadata badges, where the shift in temperature is the point.

## Ruled Sheet Geometry

The page is laid out like drafting film. Dashed vertical guides mark a 1128px frame and its quarter divisions, and full-width hairlines close each section. The four-up stat tiles and the four-column hero split sit on those guides. This visible scaffolding replaces shadows and colored bands as the organizing device. It is the reason a 4.57px maximum blur is enough and the reason surfaces only shift between #fafafa, #ffffff and #ededed. It breaks when a section adopts its own off-grid centered layout, when guide lines are dropped on some sections but kept on others, or when card gutters ignore the 16px rhythm. Extend it by snapping new modules to halves or quarters of the 1080px column. Bleed is reserved for media, as the feature panel already shows.

## Quarantined Color

Saturated hue is contained, not spread. The peach-violet gradient lives only inside the 24px-radius hero stage and the feature media panels. Purple and green entity highlights live only inside the mockup's sentence. Ember Signal #ff6020 lives only in the announcement link. Holding that boundary is non-negotiable, because the monochrome chrome is what makes the demo the brightest object on the page. It breaks the moment the gradient becomes a section background, a CTA picks up orange, or icons pick up the mockup purples. To extend the system, give any new illustration its own framed 8–24px-radius container, keep the chrome in Carbon Ink, and treat color as evidence shown inside the product, not as brand decoration.

## Similar Brands

- **Stripe** — Shares the visible vertical guide lines across the page and a saturated gradient confined to a hero stage, though Panxo keeps CTAs in ink while Stripe uses its violet.
- **Vercel** — Same near-black pill primary, white ring-shadow secondary pill, and grid-line scaffolding on an off-white canvas, but Panxo's ink is warm brown-black rather than pure black.
- **Attio** — Matches the medium-weight display headlines with tight tracking and the hairline-ringed white cards over a #fafafa-style base.
- **Framer** — Same ring-shadow elevation (0px-blur spread plus a tiny drop) and frosted-glass chips floating over a soft gradient render.
- **The Trade Desk** — A category competitor in programmatic advertising, which Panxo answers with a quieter, specification-sheet tone instead of dashboard-heavy color.
